title: Comelec dismisses ‘no-el’ in 2028 claims anew

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has once again dismissed resurfacing claims that there will be a “no-el” (no elections) scenario in 2028 as it emphasized that the poll body is currently preparing for the much-anticipated elections.
